findings.body: Raise: Not done. Both checked-in host guides differ from the template that `story.ships` writes during `forge sync`. For example, `src/forge/templates/skill.md:210` describes `kind_stage_counts`, while `.claude/skills/forge/SKILL.md:210` and the identical Codex copy retain older board guidance; the copies also omit current task-size and cold-read guidance. The new guide test checks copies generated in a fixture, so it cannot catch this mismatch. Item 9's required synced copies have not been delivered, and the proof list's template-comparison claim is unsupported by the checked-in files.
findings.title: Not done: synced skill copies match the template
